paragraphs.text: Many Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate cards feature flavor text that is not visible on the cards themselves, but appears in a separate pop-up box when hovering over the card. These are not listed on Scryfall .

Cards in the set that were reprinted from Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms , the Forgotten Realms Commander decks or Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate retain their original flavor text from those sets.
